about: What each painted place in art/backdrops/manifest.json is, so a picture pipeline knows what exists and a scene can be matched to a fitting one. Read by scripts/scene-pictures (the gap report) and checked by tests/guards/scene-pictures.test.ts: every manifest place has exactly one row here. Light and weather variants are not repeated here; the manifest and the report read them. Sorted from each place's name and manifest tags (kind:, light:, home:, region: and the like), basis: "image" means the picture was looked at (44 places) and "name" that the group, settings and scenes come from the place's name and manifest tags alone (267 places), so a later pass knows which to trust. group: what kind of place; serves: the scene setting kinds (home, other-home, workplace, school, public, venue, office, chamber, seat) it can be drawn for; offices: the office kinds (core2-offices-v1) whose seat, office or room it fits; scenes: situation types it suits best. To add a picture, add its manifest rows and one row here.
